survey: A flying saucer floating on a plain yellow radial background, with no ground plane. We see it from slightly above, and the whole craft is tilted so its right side is a little higher. Main parts: (1) a brushed-steel conical hull. Its top surface reads as a flattened ellipse at roughly a 0.4 height-to-width ratio, and the brushing follows the cone. (2) A dark rounded bumper ring around the rim. It is thickest and lowest at the front and thins toward the back, as expected from above. (3) A recessed metal collar at the hull's centre. Its ellipse is tilted and squashed about the same as the hull. (4) A green glass hemisphere dome sitting in the collar, seen slightly from above, centred on the hull. (5) Orange marker lights spaced along the bumper. They are biggest and most widely spaced at the front, and smaller and bunched toward the sides and back, so they follow the rim's curve. Every part agrees on one camera and one tilt.
